newsitem.title: USA: Apple, IBM to negotiate license fees - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Apple, IBM to negotiate license fees - NYT.

text.p: Apple Computer and International Business Machines Corp plan on Wednesday to renegotiate license fees for Apple's Macintosh operating system software, the New York Times said.

Having decided to let other companies clone its Macintosh computers, Apple has now shown signs of regretting the move and has proposed boosting Macintosh license fees as much as 10 times, the paper said.

Apple told IBM license fees would be raised even for the company's long-time partner, the Times said, citing executives close to the company. This created a division between the two firms, the paper said.
People familiar with the talks said the companies would meet via video conference on Wednesday to discuss the issue, the paper said.
